title: Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESI/ESIC) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Contributory social security and medical benefit scheme providing healthcare and related social-security benefits to insured employees and eligible family members.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Employees covered under the ESI Act and applicable wage/employment coverage conditions, plus eligible dependants; contribution and establishment coverage rules apply.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESI/ESIC).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
